steps: Saved animation remains initially static after frozen SVG decoding. Scrubbing one second draws the existing image at its offset, 90-degree rotation, 2×/0.5× scale and 0.5 opacity. The second instance of the same projection keeps identical pixels. Stop restores exact static canvas pixels; layout is enabled again.
Zoom and a real middle-button drag remain usable on a sampled frame. Stop changes only the visual layer, retaining the panned view; Fit remains explicit.

Chinese, English and Japanese fit a 390px viewport and retain the same focused timeline and exact paused time. Changing language during playback retains playing state. The browser visibility handler pauses without advancing the frozen sample.

ja.heading: 保存済みシーンアニメーション

limitations: Real Chrome local HTTP authoring preview in a disposable copied example; no packaged Tauri/Android or engine runtime claim.
Only saved Scene2D visual animation is played; behavior, physics, audio, frame animation and composition playback are excluded.
Background pause is exercised by dispatching the browser visibility event with an explicitly overridden hidden state, not OS tab scheduling.
